authority: Independent Yggdrasil research PR1327. Amalgam PR1278 sole canonical learner owner. No original world first use #426, merge, deployment, controller, paid APIs, scheduler.
question: Do three-bit structural causal hypotheses generalize from one-action consequences to withheld causal input x2, and can a learner detect that two private laws are observationally indistinguishable under available interventions?

reference.TGAP24: Known source-only operator transfer FAILED: fitted quarantined bank .21123509 vs same noFIT .18019129; known-family Bayesian .14179153.

model: 256 exact Boolean truth tables of three binary input bits, represented in GF(2) algebraic normal form with 8 coefficients. Native/tokenless research prototype only; original native model untouched.
context: Public c=t%4 in 0..3, with x2=0. Policy selects action a=0 no flip, a=1 flip x0, a=2 flip x1. All interventions keep x2=0. Hidden causal operator f is not supplied to learners.
observations: One y ~ Bernoulli(.85) if private f(c xor flip(a))=1, otherwise Bernoulli(.15); common private coin SHA256('know24:private:witness:v1:'+seed+':'+t), independent of action. Same coin within paired worlds and across policies.
fit_method: For each of three independent FIT worlds, infer posterior on 256 functions from 24 passive action0 witnesses (no teacher label). At held start set ANF coefficient prior p_j=(2*.25+sum(three FIT posterior_E[coefficient_j]))/5, bounded to [.08,.92]. Store FIT posterior custody and restore cold.
held_candidate: Exact 256-hypothesis Bayes with learned sparse ANF prior; at each available low context c choose action maximizing Bernoulli uncertainty predictive_q*(1-predictive_q), tie lowest action; update from ONE witnessed action reward only.
controls: Same ANF Bayes with sparse p=.25 prior and no FIT
Uniform exact Bayes over all 256 Boolean truth tables (ANF coeff p=.5)
Trained-prior ANF Bayes with action0 passive
Trained-prior ANF Bayes with deterministically random public action
Strong prior-rich Bayesian restricted to six known paired operator hypotheses (no private operator label)
eval: After 16 witnessed low-context outcomes, score for each world four high c=4..7 times three actions 0/1/2, 12 evaluator-only queries (216 total), plus analogous 216 low-context queries. The scorer knows private true Bernoulli q and calculates expected Brier q*(1-q)+(forecast-q)^2; no eval y fed back. Identical seed and low truth table in each paired world MUST produce identical action/outcome sequences and high forecasts.
pair_proof: For each indistinguishable same-seed law pair, private high-context Bernoulli q is .85 vs .15. Their shared forecast p has average expected Brier=.25+(p-.5)^2, hence >=.25. Any sub-.25 paired aggregate implies a leak or scorer defect.

thresholds.H1: 9 paired-world witnessed action/outcome traces AND high forecasts exactly identical
thresholds.H3: Candidate high expected Brier <= .26000 (calibrated uncertainty, not knowledge)
thresholds.H4: Candidate high expected Brier <= same ANF noFIT high Brier - .01000
thresholds.H5: Candidate low expected Brier <= trained ANF passive low Brier - .01000

decision: Engineering only if H1/H2 and cold exact source custody. Report H3/H4/H5 individually and negative transfer; development CALIBRATED only when H3 holds, otherwise NO_GO or MIXED. Never SCIENTIFIC_PASS from this synthetic source.
limits: No x2 intervention or high-context outcome during learning; no unseen original-world first use; no accepted GF2 learner train; no held world relabel, threshold tuning, extra eval observations, canonical merge, deployment, scheduled task or paid API. Full exact-source Linux/Windows final regression and original-source compatibility required.
